desc: Derive the exact structural characterization of the maximum attainable interval for one starting slime.
Prove the recurrence/greedy property used to decide which neighboring slimes can be absorbed, including strict-equality barriers.
Develop a globally shared Cartesian-tree algorithm for all starting positions in subquadratic time.
Work out subtree-sum formulas and edge cases involving equal sizes and strict inequality.
Implement and validate the final Python algorithm within the required complexity.
Confirm the solution passes both public sample tests.
